description: This file defines a React component for a Costs page in a data management dashboard. It includes UI elements such as a data table, modal inspector, and tree view for detailed exploration of cost records related to large language models (LLMs). The component manages state, fetches data from an API, and provides interactive features like search, sorting, and detailed inspection.

methods.name: openInspector
methods.description: Opens the inspector modal with a specified title and payload for detailed view.

methods.name: closeInspector
methods.description: Closes the inspector modal and clears the payload.
